name: sci-form
description: **High-performance 3D molecular conformer generation** using ETKDG distance geometry, written in Rust.

scripts.wasm:build:all-alpha: bash crates/wasm/build.sh --web-only --web-features "alpha-dynamics-live alpha-dft alpha-reaxff alpha-mlff alpha-obara-saika alpha-cga alpha-gsm alpha-sdr alpha-imd"
scripts.wasm:build:all-beta: bash crates/wasm/build.sh --web-only --web-features "beta-kpm beta-mbh beta-randnla beta-riemannian beta-cpm"
scripts.wasm:build:full: bash crates/wasm/build.sh --web-only --web-features "alpha-dynamics-live alpha-dft alpha-reaxff alpha-mlff alpha-obara-saika alpha-cga alpha-gsm alpha-sdr alpha-imd beta-kpm beta-mbh beta-randnla beta-riemannian beta-cpm"

author: Sci-Form Team (https://github.com/jigonzalez930209/sci-form)
